name: atelier
description: Cowork-style desktop AI workspace: Go host service + Python/OpenHands guest agent + Electron/React UI. See docs/README.md.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:go && npm run lint:py && npm run lint:md
scripts.lint:py: cd packages/partisan && uv run ruff check .
scripts.lint:sec: uvx semgrep@1.165.0 scan --config p/golang --config p/python --config p/typescript --config p/nodejs --config p/secrets --config p/trailofbits --metrics off --error --disable-version-check
scripts.lint:cve: npm run lint:cve:go && npm run lint:cve:deps
scripts.lint:cve:go: cd services && go run golang.org/x/vuln/cmd/govulncheck@v1.3.0 -show verbose ./...
scripts.security: npm run lint:sec && npm run lint:cve
scripts.format: npm run format:js && npm run format:go && npm run format:py && npm run lint:md:fix
scripts.format:py: cd packages/partisan && uv run ruff format .
